mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering a 60-day decline in S&P 500 returns as corporate earnings growth expectations fall.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a rising labor force participation rate (PAYEMS) signals tight labor market conditions that drive inflationary pressures, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 4.0%, a rise in PAYEMS does not produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for PAYEMS falls below 0.03 in low UNRATE regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates strengthening supply chain conditions and manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO has increased over the past month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5% for three consecutive months, it signals persistent inflation that prompts restrictive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicate tightening monetary policy amid persistent inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production regime (INDPRO > 115.0), a decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a weakening economic expansion that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO > 115.0, a decline in GDPC1 does not produce negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for GDPC1 falls below 0.03 in high INDPRO regime.
